decision.text: Item 1 (list_agents live rows) was already landed in 9374a54db (2026-10-17): no code change, re-measured on the private Servex. Alternative: re-implement it; rejected, it would duplicate the shipped filter.

Item 4 gate lives in Servex/Landed.js (Landed.of_file/of_dir count a landing only when LandingCheck says the assign.branch work is on michael/dev) and is Servex-side only: Task.replay and Server/State.mjs are unchanged. Alternative: put it in Task.replay; rejected, a browser cannot run git. Also rejected: a raw `git log michael/dev..branch` count, because merge.mjs sometimes lands a branch by applying its diff (Servex/doc/landing.md item 2), so the existing by-content check is used. Known edge: a reused pool-slot branch with new unmerged work can make an old landed task read unlanded; the check fails open when the branch is gone or has no assign.branch.

Item 2 is a prompt-level fix: no Servex code sends the repeated reports, the recipient model does, so the envelope now says 'reply to X (once: in the turn that answers this message, never after it unless a new message arrives)'. Alternative: Servex strips reply_to after the first turn; rejected, the agent already holds the text in its context. The before-fix baseline was not measured.

Item 3: the shared :8090 cors middleware already sent Allow-Origin *; the real gap was the worktree stub on POST /card (no CORS header at all), and * for any origin. /card/append and the stub now use a localhost-only cors (origin echoed + Vary) via Cards.routes(router, cors, append_cors); other card routes keep the shared cors. Fence note: touched Servex/cards/Cards.js (3 lines) because the route is registered there.
